description: This file defines the HttpEndpoint interface in a Java project, which extends another interface Endpoint and declares a method addRoutes for adding HTTP request handling routes using Vert.x Router.

classes.name: HttpEndpoint
classes.description: An interface for HTTP endpoints that extends Endpoint and provides a method to add routes to handle HTTP requests.

methods.name: addRoutes
methods.description: Method to add custom routes to the provided Vert.x Router for handling HTTP requests.
